# OpenBB Docs - odp/cli

## Docs

- [Authentication](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/auth): Static headers, query parameters, and importable auth hooks for the HTTP backends, with the AuthContext and AuthDecision contract used for RBAC and per-request credentials.

- [Backends](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/backends): How openbb-cli resolves commands in-process, against an openbb-api or other OpenAPI 3.x server, from a .spec file, and across several specs mounted under namespaces.

- [Codegen](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/codegen): Save an OpenAPI document or a Socrata story as a .spec file, and generate an installable OpenBB extension project from a .spec file.

- [Configuration](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/configuration): How openbb-cli combines openbb.toml files, pyproject.toml, .env files, environment variables, and flags, and which keys each source accepts.

- [ODP CLI](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/index): Command-line client for the OpenBB Platform and any OpenAPI 3.x server, with one-shot dispatch, NDJSON batch mode, an interactive REPL, and extension code generation.

- [Installation](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/installation): Install openbb-cli with pip, add the OpenBB extensions that supply commands, and choose the charting and interactive-window extras.

- [Modes](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/modes): One-shot dispatch, NDJSON batch, and the interactive REPL, with argument parsing rules, the request and response wire format, and exit codes.

- [Quickstart](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/quickstart): Run one command in-process, through an openbb-api server, and from a .spec file, send a batch over stdin, and open the REPL.

- [CLI flags](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/reference/cli-flags): Every flag accepted by openbb, with its default, environment variable fallback, and behavior.

- [Commands and Arguments](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/commands-and-arguments): Reading command help, passing parameters, the flags the REPL adds to every data command, and tab completion and history in the ODP CLI REPL.

- [Data Sources](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/data-sources): How providers map to menus in the ODP CLI REPL, when --provider matters, and where provider credentials and default parameters come from.

- [Interactive Charts](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/interactive-charts): Drawing charts in the ODP CLI REPL with --chart and results --chart, what the chart window offers, and what the charting and interactive extras add.

- [Interactive Tables](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/interactive-tables): How the ODP CLI REPL displays results in each output mode, when tables open in a PyWry window, and how to filter a table with the Pandas Query toolbar.

- [OpenBBUserData Folder](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/openbbuserdata): Where the ODP CLI REPL reads and writes files: the OpenBBUserData folders set in the OpenBB user preferences, and the CLI's own files in ~/.openbb_platform.

- [Results Registry](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/results): How the ODP CLI REPL caches command results, how to reuse them as input, load files into the cache, and reshape or save cached tables in the /feature menu.

- [Advanced Routines](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/routines/advanced-routines): Parameterize ODP CLI routines with input arguments, variables, relative date keywords, and foreach loops.

- [Routines](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/routines/index): Script ODP CLI REPL sessions as .openbb routine files, record them from a live session, and parameterize them with inputs, variables, dates, and loops.

- [Introduction to Routines](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/routines/introduction-to-routines): The .openbb routine format, how the REPL turns a routine into one sequence of steps, and how to run a routine with exe.

- [Routine Macro Recorder](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/routines/routine-macro-recorder): Record the steps of a live ODP CLI REPL session into a .openbb routine with record and stop, and where the recorded file is saved.

- [Structure and Navigation](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/repl/structure-and-navigation): How the ODP CLI REPL is organized into menus and commands, how to move between them with relative and absolute paths, and which commands work everywhere.

- [Settings](https://docs.openbb.co/odp/cli/settings): REPL display and behavior settings, where they are stored, how to change them from the /settings menu, and what each one does.
